tagline: Parse CVs into skills, experience, and applicant records
problem: Recruiters manually retype CV data into Odoo Recruitment for every applicant.
solution: Resume AI Parser extracts skills, experience, and contact details from uploads and ranks applicants for faster shortlisting.

features.text: Sort applicants by parsed fit signals.
